rca_of_the_issue: PayPal plan creation 502 RCA: paypal_client.py used 'POST /v1/catalog/products' (singular). PayPal's actual endpoint is '/v1/catalogs/products' (plural, per https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/catalog-products/v1/). PayPal returned 404 'Resource not found' which bubbled up as HTTP 502 from the API. Mitigation: replaced both POST and GET endpoints to use the plural form. Verified by re-running test_create_and_list_plan — now PASSES.
